DateOfFirstSubscription.name: Date Of First Subscription
DateOfFirstSubscription.definition: Date of the first subscription in the current year.

EquityComponent.name: Equity Component
EquityComponent.definition: Amount subscribed in the current tax year into equities (not including dividends).

CashComponent.name: Cash Component
CashComponent.definition: Amount subscribed in the current tax year into cash.

TotalAmountYearToDate.name: Total Amount Year To Date
TotalAmountYearToDate.definition: Total amount subscribed in the current tax year.

TotalAmountYearToDateRule.definition: TotalAmountYearToDate must be equal to the sum of EquityComponent and CashComponent if present.
